sentences.en: Algerian students need to be encouraged to think independently.
sentences.zh: 鼓励阿尔及利亚学生独立思考。

sentences.en: This teaching method puts an emphasis on learning independently.
sentences.zh: 这种方法强调自主学习。

sentences.en: Calculus was developed by Newton and Leibniz independently.
sentences.zh: 微积分是由牛顿和莱布尼茨分别独立发展出来的。
